one_liner: The 3 answers become 3 chats in Advanced reasoning mode, and each chat stays in that mode for good.
author: aadi

change.title: Existing opportunity: Welcome-back card: 3 chats in Advanced reasoning mode, kept for good
change.what_is_different_here: The Luzia+ paywall (s02) lists 'Advanced reasoning mode' (s02.e03) as a paid feature. A returning free user gets 3 chats in it from the Chats home (s01), under the existing Luzia+ badge (s01.e02), and each of those chats stays in that mode for good. Every other chat, and the full feature, stays behind the Weekly / Monthly / Annual plans and the 3-day trial (s02.e19).
change.offer_copy: Welcome back! Play a short game to get 3 chats in Advanced reasoning mode, Luzia+'s deeper-thinking mode. Each one stays in that mode for good.

reward.unit: chats in Advanced reasoning mode, each staying in that mode for good

flow_steps.caption: A user who hasn't opened Luzia in 3+ days lands on Chats as usual.
A welcome-back card offers 3 chats in Advanced reasoning mode, kept for good, for a short game.
The user plays a short sponsored game and can close it at any time.
The card changes to '3 Advanced reasoning chats ready. They stay in that mode for good. Start a chat.'

change.after_reward: The 3 chats stay in Advanced reasoning mode for good. Every other chat uses the normal mode, and a small note on Chats says Luzia+ turns Advanced reasoning mode on in every chat and shows the 3-day free trial button.
change.rationale: A lapsing user needs a reason to ask Luzia something today. Three chats that keep Luzia+'s deeper-thinking mode are a lasting reason to come back, and they double as a preview of Luzia+. Each answer uses real model time, so it pays for itself in higher-earning markets like North America. In lower-earning markets it should drop to 1 chat or need a second game.
